author: XboxDan
quote:
Incredible game, the very best I have ever played, it's not just one thing, the audio, visuals, radio, music choices, lighting, story, it all comes together to just be something way bigger than it has any right to be.

This is testament to what can happen when you give the best talent in the industry a nearly unlimited budget and 8 years to perfect the thing they are building.

It's also the smoothest and most responsive 30fps game I've ever played, ignore the review bombers, they are just angry that they don't get to play it on the platform of their choice.
